platform_red.reason: Times out on macOS (2 s on air, 15 s on eight; release runs 39507156420 and 39512102477) and passes on Linux and Windows. Matching the watched target through its real parent path did not fix it; a race with the asynchronous FSEvents stream start or event delivery is unproven and needs debug logging on a Mac. Impact: on macOS a provider CLI update refreshes the catalogue only on TTL or restart.

On the Windows test runner BLACKSTAR-windows-x64 the PTY stream does not end within 30 s after the shell runs exit 3 (tier dry run 39572977803); it passed on ROG in every earlier run. ConPTY shell exit on that machine is under investigation.
